source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
No player controls any objective when the battle begins. To control one, a player needs models with an OC of at least 1 in range of it; for a terrain objective, being inside its terrain area counts as in range.

As each phase and each turn ends, before any other rules or abilities triggered then, add up the OC values of all a player's models in range of each objective to get their level of control there:

- The higher level controls it.
- Equal levels leave it uncontrolled unless it is secured (14.03).

A unit of the controlling player counts as controlling the objective while the unit is in range and has a model whose OC is at least 1.
